closures.finding: Unchecked revisions, ignored table tail text, and overbroad unsupported routing.
closures.resolution: Revision conflicts and unexpected text reject; unknown/foreign/unauthorized routes remain failures; bounded documented alternatives may be inconclusive. Parsed submitted content drives native state rather than returning a fixed successful answer.

closures.finding: CREATE normalization did not establish UPDATE empty-text behavior.
closures.resolution: New positive task explicitly requests zero and null. Empty-text updates are unsupported before mutation; complete signed effects and unrelated state remain checked.

closures.finding: Folder page size ignored; native bot self-grant initially unmodeled.

closures.finding: Some search filters lacked modeled relationships; discovery needed strategy-independent command validation.
closures.resolution: Concrete email predicates apply; unmodeled relationship filters are explicit. Discovery probes only the selected immutable CLI with safe argv in a separate fixture after the agent; probe API calls are excluded from agent API counts.
